fang_bounty.name: Fang Bounty
fang_bounty.accept_text: You have taken on a task: Fang Bounty. Collect four gnoll fangs and trade them to Warden Holt.
fang_bounty.complete_text: Four fangs, and not a bite on you. Good work, {name}. Here's your bounty. The watch pays for every four you bring.
fang_bounty.first_complete_text: Take this blade as well. It served me before I earned a better one. May it serve you as well.
fang_bounty.ready_text: Those look like gnoll fangs you're carrying, {name}. Hand them over.
